description: This file defines a command execution framework for a trading platform, including classes for handling execution context, building function parameters, and executing commands synchronously and asynchronously. It also contains a CommandRunner class that manages command mapping, system and user settings, and orchestrates command execution.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Holds the context of command execution, including command map, route, system, and user settings.

classes.name: ParametersBuilder
classes.description: Provides static methods for analyzing, merging, validating, and building function parameters for command execution.

classes.name: StaticCommandRunner
classes.description: Contains static methods to execute commands asynchronously, handle charting, and process warnings.

classes.name: CommandRunner
classes.description: Main class managing command execution flow, including initialization with command map and settings, and providing methods for running commands synchronously and asynchronously.
